definitions.explanation: A sensation of unease and discomfort in the stomach with an urge to vomit.

examples.japanese: {船|ふね}に{乗|の}ったら{吐|は}き{気|け}がしてきた。
examples.english: I started feeling nauseous when I got on the boat.

examples.japanese: {吐|は}き{気|け}がひどくて{何|なに}も{食|た}べられない。
examples.english: The nausea is so bad that I can't eat anything.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}の{副作用|ふくさよう}で{吐|は}き{気|け}がする。
examples.english: I feel nauseous as a side effect of the medication.

notes:
{吐|は}き{気|け} refers to the feeling of nausea. It comes from {吐|は}く (to vomit) + {気|け} (feeling/tendency).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {吐|は}き{気|け}がする: to feel nauseous
- {吐|は}き{気|け}を{催|もよお}す: to feel the urge to vomit
- {吐|は}き{気|け}を{抑|おさ}える: to suppress nausea
- {吐|は}き{気|け}を{止|と}める: to stop nausea
- {激|はげ}しい{吐|は}き{気|け}: severe nausea

COMMON CAUSES:
- {乗|の}り{物|もの}{酔|よ}い: motion sickness
- つわり: morning sickness
- {食|しょく}あたり: food poisoning
- {二日酔|ふつかよ}い: hangover
- {副作用|ふくさよう}: medication side effects

RELATED WORDS:
- {吐|は}く: to vomit
- {嘔吐|おうと}: vomiting (medical term)
- {気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}い: feeling sick/unwell
